posts.text:
Your agent can speak in more than 300 voices, and three.ws/voice lets you hear them before you pick one, without signing in.

They sit in one grid you search by name, accent or use case: en-GB leaves 5. Press Use this voice, type a line, press Speak, and the playground reads it back. The Microsoft Edge and NVIDIA Magpie voices are free and need no account.

Each clip is cached against the whole request (voice, text and speed), so a line asked for twice is served from storage with no new synthesis.

To use your own voice instead, record 20 to 30 seconds on the same page and clone it. Cloning runs on ElevenLabs, on credits or your own key. Either way the voice works across your avatars and agents.
